explorer.searchPlaceholder: Search messages, or filter with key=value
explorer.searchHint: Filter with key=value, key!=value, key~text, key>n or has:key. Other words match the message.
explorer.partial: Some storage did not answer, so these results may be incomplete.
explorer.failed: The search failed. Check your connection and try again.
explorer.noMatchText: Widen the time range, clear a level or change the search.
explorer.caption: Log events, newest first
explorer.narrow: You reached the page limit. Narrow the search to see older events.

section.soonText: This section is not available in this version.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: This address does not match a page or a project you can open.

projects.title: All projects
projects.none: This workspace has no projects yet.
projects.createWorkspaceText: A workspace holds your projects and the people who can see them.
projects.projectHint: New projects start with a production environment and a default stream.
projects.forbidden: Your role in this workspace cannot do this. Ask an owner or an admin.
projects.conflict: That name is already in use. Choose another.
projects.failed: That did not work. Try again.

login.unreachableText: Check that Ervisio Logs is running, then try again.
login.closedText: Registration is closed. Ask an administrator to create your account.

hint.password: At least 10 characters, different from email and username.

invalid.usernameStart: Start with a letter or a digit.
invalid.usernameChars: Use only lowercase letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore.
invalid.passwordSame: Must differ from email and username.

setup.where: The server writes the setup code to its logs at startup.
setup.find: Find this line and copy the value of setup_code:

login.400: Invalid request. Reload the page and try again.
login.401: Wrong email, username or password. Check them and try again.
login.403: Request refused. Reload the page and try again.
login.413: Too much data. Shorten the fields and try again.
login.429: Too many attempts. Try again in {{wait}}.
login.503: The server is busy. Try again shortly.

register.400: Invalid request. Reload the page and try again.
register.403: Registration is closed. Ask an administrator to create your account.
register.409: Email or username already in use. Sign in, or choose others.
register.413: Too much data. Shorten the fields and try again.
register.422: The server rejected this data. Check the fields and try again.
register.429: Too many attempts. Try again in {{wait}}.
register.503: The server is busy. Try again shortly.

setup.400: Invalid request. Reload the page and try again.
setup.403: Setup code wrong or already used. Copy the latest code from the server logs.
setup.409: Email or username already in use. Choose others.
setup.413: Too much data. Shorten the fields and try again.
setup.422: The server rejected this data. Check the fields and try again.
setup.429: Too many attempts. Try again in {{wait}}.
setup.503: The server is busy. Try again shortly.

login.fallbackText: Try again. If this continues, tell whoever runs the server.

action.login: Sign in with email and password

fallback.title: Sign in failed
fallback.text: Try again. If this continues, tell whoever runs the server.

provider_denied.title: Sign in cancelled
provider_denied.text: The provider did not grant access. Try again, or use email and password.

invalid_request.title: Incomplete response from the provider
invalid_request.text: The response is missing data. Try again from the provider button.

invalid_state.title: Invalid sign in request
invalid_state.text: The request expired or started in another browser. Try again from this browser.

exchange_failed.title: The provider did not complete sign in
exchange_failed.text: Try again shortly. If this continues, use email and password or tell an administrator.

email_unverified.title: Email not verified
email_unverified.text: The provider does not confirm your email. Verify it in your provider account, then try again.

email_in_use.title: This email already has an account
email_in_use.text: The account has a password and the email is not verified, so the provider cannot link to it. Sign in with email and password.

identity_conflict.title: Provider linked to another profile
identity_conflict.text: Your account already uses another profile from this provider. Sign in with that profile, or with email and password.

registration_closed.title: Registration is closed
registration_closed.text: No account uses this email and new users are not accepted. Ask an administrator to create your account.

setup_required.title: The first administrator is missing
setup_required.text: You create the first account with the setup code, not with a provider.

account_disabled.title: Account disabled
account_disabled.text: Ask an administrator to reactivate it.

server_error.title: Server error
server_error.text: Sign in failed. Try again shortly. If this continues, tell whoever runs the server.

live.noFilters: Live view does not support key=value filters. Remove them to go live.
live.waitingText: New events that match these filters appear here as they arrive.

first.title: Send the first event to {{project}}
first.text: Connect a server in three steps. It takes about a minute.
first.step1Text: Your server sends events with this token. It can only write logs to this project.
first.step2Text: Run this from your server, or send a test event from here.
first.tokenOnce: Copy the token now. You will not see it again after you leave this page.
first.testMessage: Test event from the setup page
first.forbidden: You need permission to manage tokens. Ask a project admin.
first.tokenFailed: Could not create the token. Try again.
first.sendFailed: The test event was not accepted. Try again or use the command above.

tokens.intro: Servers and scripts use API tokens to send or read logs. Each token belongs to this project.
tokens.createdText: Copy it now. You will not see it again.
tokens.forbidden: You need permission to manage tokens. Ask a project admin.
tokens.revokeConfirm: Revoke {{name}}? Anything using it stops working.
tokens.name: Name

users.intro: These people can open {{workspace}} and every project in it. A role sets what each person can do.
users.forbidden: You need permission to manage members. Ask a workspace owner or admin.
users.lastOwner: A workspace needs at least one owner. Make someone else owner first.
users.emailHint: The person needs an account on this instance already.
users.noAccount: No account uses this email. Ask an instance admin to create it first.
users.already: This person is already a member.

roleText.owner: Everything, including workspace settings and granting the owner role.
roleText.admin: Manage members, tokens, storage and alerts. Read, export and delete logs.
roleText.developer: Create projects and tokens, set up alerts, read and export logs.

storage.adminOnly: Retention and archive destinations apply to the whole server. Ask the person who set up Ervisio Logs to change them.
storage.watermarks: Above {{high}}% the archiver moves the oldest archived data off this disk until usage falls to {{low}}%.
storage.overCapacity: Disk is over the cap and nothing more can leave it. Raise the cap, add an archive destination, or shorten local retention.
storage.failedSegments_one: {{count}} segment failed to upload. The archiver retries it on its next pass.
storage.failedSegments_other: {{count}} segments failed to upload. The archiver retries them on its next pass.
storage.archiverOff: The archiver is off on this server, so logs stay on local disk until global retention deletes them. Set ARCHIVE_ENABLED=true to turn it on.
storage.usageUnavailable: Disk usage is unavailable right now because ClickHouse did not answer.
storage.projectIntro: Keep this project's logs for a different time than the server default.
storage.inheritHint: Leave a field empty to use the server default shown in grey.
storage.overrideEmpty: Fill in at least one field, or use the server default.
storage.saveFailed: Retention did not save. Try again.
storage.resetDone: This project now uses the server default.
storage.instanceIntro: Applies to every project without its own retention.
storage.localHint: After this, logs move to the archive destination.
storage.globalHint: After this, logs are deleted everywhere.
storage.capHint: The cap covers hot data and the archive cache together.
storage.instanceIncomplete: The server default needs both day counts and a disk cap.
storage.globalBeforeLocal: Days before deletion must be at least the days on local disk.
storage.noActive: No destination receives archives. Logs stay on local disk until global retention deletes them.
storage.stopConfirm: Stop archiving? Logs will stay on local disk until global retention deletes them.
storage.deleteConfirm: Remove {{name}}? Ervisio Logs refuses if archived logs still live there.
storage.actionFailed: That did not work. Check the connection and try again.

secretHint.s3: A JSON file in the secrets folder with access_key and secret_key. Ervisio Logs never sends credentials through the browser.
secretHint.sftp: A file in the secrets folder holding the unencrypted private key. Ervisio Logs never sends credentials through the browser.
secretHint.sftpPassword: A file in the secrets folder holding only the password. Ervisio Logs never sends credentials through the browser.

storage.addFailed: The destination was not added. Try again.
storage.addedUnhealthy: {{name}} was added, but Ervisio Logs cannot reach it. Fix the settings, then check the connection.

alerts.intro: An alert counts the events that match a search over a time window and notifies your channels when the count goes above the threshold, and again when it drops back.
alerts.forbidden: You can't see alerts in this project.
alerts.none: No alerts yet. Create one to get notified when errors pile up.
alerts.deleteConfirm: Delete the alert "{{name}}"? Its history goes too.
alerts.noChannels: No notification channels yet, so alerts only change state here.
alerts.name: Name
alerts.matchHint: Same syntax as the search box. Leave it empty to count every event at the chosen levels.
alerts.thresholdHint_one: Fires when more than {{count}} event matches.
alerts.thresholdHint_other: Fires when more than {{count}} events match.
alerts.thresholdInvalid: The threshold must be a whole number, 0 or more.

channels.intro: Channels are where alerts go. Each one is a webhook: your own endpoint, a Slack incoming webhook or a Discord webhook.

formatHint.ervisio: A JSON body signed with a secret, so your endpoint can check it came from this server.
formatHint.slack: A text message for a Slack incoming webhook.
formatHint.discord: A text message for a Discord channel webhook.

channels.forbidden: You can't see channels in this workspace.
channels.rotateConfirm: Make a new secret for "{{name}}"? The current one stops working right away.
channels.deleteConfirm: Delete the channel "{{name}}"? Alerts using it stop notifying there.
channels.secretText: Copy it now and store it with your endpoint. You won't see it again; make a new one if you lose it.
channels.name: Name
channels.urlHint: Must be https. Only the host is shown after you save.
